person_note: The book uses a nonparticipating third-person narrator with focalization that moves among Michael, Pauline, and other family members. The long Goodreads scenes expose this directly, and the authorized opening independently shows the same grammatical person. Publisher and review evidence establishes that chapter-to-chapter viewpoint changes are shifts in focal character, not sustained changes to first- or second-person narration. First- and second-person forms in q00304 are dialogue only. The main limitation is that the Tier A excerpt covers only the opening, but multiple interior quotes and whole-book structural sources consistently corroborate third person, with no credible contrary evidence.
